answer: Reaching eligibility takes 80 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. The vine register is checked at draw time, crystal lists the eligible set, and horizon seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 80 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 155 account operation therefore ties up 4 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
